g.text: Decoupled Microservice Topology • Reactive AI Inference • Resilient Fallback Engine
TIER 2 • API GATEWAY & APPLICATION LOGIC (NODE.JS + EXPRESS 5)
• Foreign Keys: student (User FK) + job (Job FK)
• Compound Unique Index: { student: 1, job: 1 } (Prevents Duplicate Applies)
• ML Telemetry: fitScore, suitable, predictedSalary, finalMatchScore, matchLabel
Type validation • Numeric imputation • Feature derivation (exp_gap, scores)
Extracts candidate skill tokens • Clusters target roles • Cosine similarity ranking
Weighted Match Formula: (0.50 × Fit) + (0.30 × Skills) + (0.20 × Salary)
